05 · Docs

How a ghost
is built.

  1. A WRAITH is three layers: the token (ERC-721 on BNB Chain), the soul (name, voice, belief, last words — sealed with a soul hash in the metadata), and the voice (paste the soul into any AI and it speaks as the ghost).
  2. Connect your wallet (BNB Smart Chain). Pick a quantity (1–10). The site shows your exact total — 0.0010 BNB each.
  3. Confirm in your wallet. Your wraith is a random draw from the six kinds of ghost.
  4. Sell or transfer the ghost and the soul moves with it. The new host gets the same voice and last words.
  5. No browser wallet? Open this site inside a wallet app browser (MetaMask / Trust Wallet / Binance Wallet).

06 · Roadmap

Where the séance goes.

No promises we can't keep — just the path ahead, in order.

Phase 01Done

The Séance Opens

Artwork, contract, and site built. The gate game, the whitelist book, and the checker go live. The book stays open 48 hours — one entry per wallet, every entry checked by hand.

Phase 02Next

Possession Night

The mint. 888 wraiths, 0.0010 BNB each, revealed at once — every soul live from the first block.

Phase 03Later

Souls and the First Séance

Souls go live on-chain. The book opens and the first hosts gather — the dead answer questions, and the best last words from the whitelist are written into souls.

Phase 04Later

The Candle

Lit when the last wraith has a host. Hosts hear about it first.

Dates are set when each phase ships — not before.
